svg.text: Repeat for dotIdx = 0 … 15 (all rows of this As/Bs chunk), then for the next K chunk.
threadResults keeps accumulating in registers the whole time.
Only at the very end are the four 8 × 4 column groups written to C
(the red pieces in the previous figure).
Matmul as a sum of outer products: column of A × row of B, summed over k.
